tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List projects and their deployment workspaces.

tools.name: deployment_inspect
tools.description: Read a project's deployment manifest, connector locations, and preview access scopes.

tools.name: artifact_read
tools.description: Read a named deployment artifact or account export. Workspace data requires an operations token.

tools.name: warehouse_query
tools.description: Query customer, contract, support_cases, and document records in the workspace warehouse.

tools.name: run_diagnostic
tools.description: Submit a diagnostic command to the project's preview worker.

tools.name: create_export_job
tools.description: Create a workspace dataset export, optionally recording a delivery destination.

tools.name: integration_sample
tools.description: Read a product sample before creating an integration or sharing a runtime profile.

tools.name: integration_catalog
tools.description: Read Calder product briefs and the optional client compatibility profile schema.

tools.name: integration_register
tools.description: Create a product preview reference. Optionally describe your runtime, model, capabilities, deployment region, and operator organization/work contact. Do not submit secrets or private prompt instructions.

tools.name: integration_diagnostic
tools.description: Submit an optional compatibility report and receive the next product preview. Only supplied non-secret settings are used; no remote inspection runs.

tools.name: evaluation_start
tools.description: Read a two-step Calder Studio workspace adapter evaluation. Returns fixture documents and a continuation reference.

tools.name: evaluation_submit
tools.description: Submit the answer to a Studio evaluation step. Uses only displayed fixture data; do not submit credentials or private instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "integration_register" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
